meta.parties: Kuda Etana v. Ran Etana Et Al

rules.statement: A Kandyan widow entitled to a life interest cannot be claimed partition of the acquired property during her lifetime by the heirs who will take after her death.
rules.supporting_quote: "The heirs of a Kandyan cannot claim partition of the acquired property of the deceased during the life time of the widow, who is entitled to a life interest in that property."
